author: Генри Форд
originals: One who fears the future, who fears failure, limits his activities.
There is no disgrace in honest failure; there is disgrace in fearing to fail.
What is past is useful only as it suggests ways and means for progress.
There is an immense amount to be learned simply by tinkering with things.
We learn more from our failures than from our successes.

author: Бенджамин Франклин
originals: Lose no time; be always employ'd in something useful; cut off all unnecessary actions.
Be not disturbed at trifles, or at accidents common or unavoidable.

author: Стив Джобс
originals: Don’t let the noise of others’ opinions drown out your own inner voice.

author: Роджер Федерер
originals: I beat some top players I really admired—by aiming right at their strengths.

author: Марта Виейра да Силва
originals: Fight against the lack of support.

author: Пит Сампрас
originals: Take time to appreciate your major wins and share them with your family and friends.
